evals.prompt: In my OutSystems Reactive app I need purchase requests to be approved by the department manager and then by finance if the amount is above 10,000. Design the workflow.
evals.expected_output: Chooses BPT (human steps, branching), places the process in <App>_BL, launches it explicitly from Request_Submit with a duplicate guard and ProcessId stored, ids-only inputs, a task entity + inbox (no Taskbox in Reactive), role/group assignment with segregation of duties, SLAs and escalation, a modeled cancel path, completion use-case actions with server-side checks, and fills the process spec.
expectations: Places the process in a Core BL (or _BPT) module, not the Front-End
Launches via Launch<Process> inside the BL submit action, not on entity Create of Request
Passes only RequestId (ids) as process input
Proposes a task entity and custom inbox because Reactive has no Taskbox
Requires server-side assignee/role checks when completing a task
Includes SLA/timeout and cancellation handling
Cites rule IDs from the skill (e.g. PAR-04, PHA-01, PDS-04)

evals.prompt: Every time an Order is created we want to send a confirmation email. A colleague built a BPT process launched on Create of Order with one automatic activity that sends the email. Is that OK?
evals.expected_output: Flags single-automatic-activity BPT (PDS-01) and entity-event launch on the business entity (PAR-04/PLT-02); recommends an outbox/event entity with a Light BPT handler or timer, idempotent handler with status/attempts, sweeper and kill switch; mentions data growth (POP-01) and imports launching processes (PLL-01).
expectations: Recommends Light BPT or outbox + timer instead of a regular BPT process
Recommends triggering on a dedicated event entity rather than Order
Mentions idempotency and failure status/retry for the handler
Mentions bulk imports or data growth as a risk

evals.prompt: We need to remove the 'LegalReview' human activity from our ContractApproval process. There are about 200 contracts in flight. Can I just delete it and publish?
evals.expected_output: No: running instances continue on the new definition; deleting an activity that holds live instances strands them (PVR-01, PLL-13). Count live instances per activity, route new instances around it, let the old ones drain, remove later; test with in-flight instances; deployment notes with a forward-fix plan.
expectations: Says not to delete an activity that has live instances
Proposes add/route-new → drain → remove
Recommends counting live instances per activity before deploying
Recommends testing against in-flight instances in a non-production environment

evals.prompt: Users say their approval task sometimes doesn't appear in the inbox even though the request shows 'Under review'. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Follows the triage: launched/ProcessId, process status, current activity status/Error, On Ready creating the task row (e.g. direct email failing in On Ready), assignment rule result, inbox filter; recommends outbox for notifications and monitoring of Error processes.
expectations: Checks the process and activity status (e.g. in Service Center) early
Checks whether the On Ready callback created the task and whether it failed
Checks the assignee resolution and the inbox query filter
Warns against fixing data directly in platform system tables

evals.prompt: Our OutSystems automatic activity calls an external API and sometimes fails. We re-raise the exception so the activity goes to Error. Last month one activity kept failing for days after the API was decommissioned. What should we change?
evals.expected_output: Explains the platform retries failed automatic activities until success or termination (no cap); proposes a committed attempt counter in the handler (CommitTransaction before re-raise), a configured MaxAttempts, a failure branch or terminate at the limit, a modeled retry path with Wait timeout as backoff for transient errors, idempotency, correlation logging and monitoring; cites PAA-06, PAA-04, PEX-03.
expectations: States that failed automatic activities are retried indefinitely by the platform
Proposes an attempt counter that survives the rollback (commit before re-raise or equivalent)
Routes to a handled failure path at a configured limit
Mentions idempotency of the step
Cites PAA-06 or another rule ID from the skill
